paite: TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na hon mangngilh nilouh ding? Bang tan ahia kei a kipan a na mai na sel ding?
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

paite: Nitum in ka lungtang a lungkhamna nei in bang tan ahia ka lungsim a ka gelgel ding? Bang tan ka melma ka tung a tawisan hi ding ahia?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, ngaihtuah inla, hon dawng in; ka mit hon hihvak in, huchi lou in zaw sihna ihmut in ka ihmu kha ding hi.
english: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

paite: Ka melma in, amah ka zouta, achi kha ding hi; ka lin leh kei hon doute akipak kha ding uhi.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw na zahngaihna ka muang ahi; na hon hotdamna ah ka lungtang akipak ding.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

paite: Ka tung a hoihtak a ahih tak ziak in, TOUPA pahtawi in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
